meta.policy: Only values read from an official government, manufacturer or official company source are shown as verified. Owner-provided and third-party values are blank and flagged UNVERIFIED. Rank ordering is a documented decision analysis, not an official rating.
meta.ranking_basis: 1) B + C-36 on one active CSLB license, 2) bond / workers compensation / complaint disclosure, 3) San Francisco address and official-site service evidence, 4) specificity of cost scope, 5) explicit gaps. No provider was contacted by this session; no provider has confirmed acceptance, availability or a price for this job. B + C-36 is a screening signal, not an exclusive lawful route: BPC §7059 permits qualifying incidental and supplemental work by specialty contractors.

candidates.name: Ace Plumbing & Rooter

It has a San Francisco address, a $25,000 bond and an active workers-compensation policy. The official company site describes HOA/property-manager work. Exact stuck-lever ability, drywall scope, availability and tenant coordination remain unverified.

Cost should be bid as one contingent written scope covering an above attempt, below access, ceiling opening/patch/finish, fill-and-inspect test and tenant schedule. flags.item: B + C-36 is a screening signal, not the only lawful arrangement
flags.why: BPC §7059 permits qualifying incidental and supplemental work by a specialty contractor. Whether this ceiling repair qualifies depends on the final scope and is not established by a CSLB classification record.
flags.action: Ask every bidder for a written scope, the responsible trades and confirmation of applicable requirements; do not reject a C-36-only firm solely on classification.

cost_notes.text: Angi’s 2026 drain-replacement guide reports a national $500–$1,020 typical range ($700 average), $45–$200/hour labor, about $2,100 for new drywall, and $1,350–$6,100 for possible water-damage work. These are publisher benchmarks, not quotes for this building.

Angi’s 2026 bathroom-leak guide reports $150–$600 for typical leak repair, a $275 average, and $300–$930 for drywall/tile follow-up. It notes that concealed pipes and access drive cost. These are publisher benchmarks, not officially confirmed values.

The three owner-provided figures dated 2026-08-30 describe an adjustment, a lever/spout replacement and a full waste-and-overflow replacement. They are transcribed only on the Project Brief and are deliberately blank in the verified value cells here. None includes a combined drywall scope.
